title: athyrium spinulosum
intro: Athyrium spinulosum, commonly known as the spiny lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in promoting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium spinulosum include its ability to act as a natural diuretic and to help lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
intro_study: According to "Journal of traditional and complementary medicine", athyrium spinulosum has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including pain, specifically breast pain during childbirth, to increase milk flow, and as an antiparasitic, anthelmintic, and carminative.
